foul_risk_meta.overall_expected_definition: Season league-average personal fouls per 40 minutes multiplied by the player's recorded minutes.
foul_risk_meta.quick_expected_definition: Monte Carlo expectation preserving each player-game foul count and sampling from that team-game's observed foul timestamps.
foul_risk_meta.censoring: An opportunity is included only when the full time window remained in the game.

win_shares_meta.method: Basketball-Reference Win Shares structure calibrated to each WNBL season
win_shares_meta.adjusted_method: Traditional Win Shares plus centered, reliability-weighted same-game plus/minus and matchup-defence signals
win_shares_meta.adjusted_team_total_rule: Adjusted player Win Shares sum to the same team total as traditional Win Shares.

stat_source: Hudl/InStat box scores collected in the WNBL dataset
